heading: cyNotice details
paragraphs: cyYou will now be asked about the notice you served to the defendants. A notice is a formal communication telling the defendants that you intend to repossess the property, like form 3A.
bullets: cythe date you served the notice
afterBullets: cyYou will also be asked to upload a copy of the notice.
cyThe defendants will be able to see your answers and any documents you upload.
